import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] f = new long[18];

    static int compute(long x) {
        int result, d = 15;
        if (x <= 11L) {
            return (int) Math.min(x, 13 - x);
        }
        while (f[d] >= x) {
            d--;
        }
        result = (int) ((x / f[d]) * d + compute(x % f[d]));
        if ((x << 1) < f[d + 1]) {
            return result;
        }
        return Math.min(result, d + compute(f[d + 1] - x) + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        f[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 16; i++) {
            f[i] = f[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute(n));
        sc.close();
    }
}
